files.lastDescription: R7's edge case that hide/show commands for every hideable tool (git tools, git drawer, console) appear in the palette and can hide/reopen the tool is proven only for the console; the git-tools and git-drawer palette commands have no test.

The plan puts the branch popover in both the panel (P9) and dialog (D10) inventories, and the R1 test cannot notice a part appearing more than once, so the 'exactly one place' acceptance is both unproven and currently false.
Hiding the git drawer loses the in-progress commit message, so R8's edge case 'Hiding the git drawer does not ... lose an in-progress git message' is not met and is not covered by a test.

R9's restart edge cases - a console open at close is not restarted and old output is not restored, and a dialog/banner/branch menu/theme finder/app edit form open at close is not reopened with stale content - have no test; only the sidebar

R10's plan-based acceptance - each building block's package or in-house decision, the jattac fallback, licence/maintenance/React 18.3 compatibility and reuse-before-adding - is not proven by any test; only the cmdk adoption and lazy load ar
